label: preparing
what: An apparently partly secret civic appreciation presentation honoring municipal public service, scheduled in the town hall great hall at 18:00 today. The appointment reveals its broad subject but explicitly keeps contents private and asks me not to arrive early. Innkeeper and local tradespeople appear to be organizing supplies and arrangements; builder supplied baker planks and a lantern. Baker, freight and neighbour were reported together at bakery. Secretary knowingly protects presentation details and manages arrival timing; neighbour's involvement is less certain. Reports of bridge or port changes remain unconfirmed and may concern a separate matter.
